note: Grep-style guardrails for things a static analyser does not call wrong but an agent must never do unasked. Patterns run case-insensitively on comment-stripped .abap files. 'context' limits a rule to files that also match it.

rules.description: DELETE FROM <table> with no WHERE clause wipes the whole table.
RAP owns the transaction; COMMIT WORK inside a handler/saver breaks it.
Kernel call into the OS shell.
Native SQL bypasses ABAP SQL, authorisations and ABAP Cloud.
Hard-coded user names are not an authorisation model.
A method that changes data must run an AUTHORITY-CHECK.
EML CREATE/UPDATE must set %control, or the fields are silently ignored.
A %cid literal reused within one EML call collides in the MAPPED response.
